explanation: I read the Sobolev-type results in Mathlib/Analysis/FunctionalSpaces/SobolevInequality.lean. They are `eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv_one`, `eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv_of_eq_inner`, `eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv_of_eq`, `eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv_of_le` and `eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv`. They cover the Gagliardo–Nirenberg–Sobolev inequality for p < n, with abstract constants. None of them covers the endpoint-or-supercritical case q ≥ n (the fderiv norm taken in L^n) with an explicit constant that depends on μ(Ω) and the volume of the unit ball. Greps for related names and for Morrey/Trudinger-type statements found nothing else. The only similar declaration is the library's own `eLpNorm_le_mul_measure_rpow_mul_eLpNorm_fderiv_of_lt`, which doesn't count.
